rationale: A -19% gap on 4.5x volume with no identified catalyst leaves price below session VWAP and 11% off the highs, and the slow drift from $12.02 to $12.25 is happening on fading 1-minute volume (last bar only 1.4k shares), so the bounce lacks conviction. Shorting at 14.2% of the daily range means selling directly into the day's low against forming higher lows, while a long has no confirmation trigger (no VWAP reclaim, price merely sitting on the 9-EMA). The 57bp spread adds ~0.6-1.1% round-trip friction that turns either marginal scalp negative-expectation, so the correct action is to wait for either a VWAP reclaim or a clean loss of the $12.00 low.
